rules.doc_title: KGR长尾词挖掘与微SaaS逆向选品SOP
rules.rule: Filter keywords using tiered KGR thresholds by search volume (SV<250: KGR<0.25; SV 250-1000: KGR<0.50; SV>1000: discard) before passing to development pipeline.
Require Opportunity Score >= 3.5 before initiating MVP development.
Disqualify keywords if top 5 SERP results lack interactive web tool landing pages.

rules.doc_title: KGR长尾词挖掘与微SaaS逆向选品SOP
rules.rule: Verify search intent via SERP analysis before committing to MVP build.

rules.doc_title: 全栈AI产品架构SOP（Next.js + Supabase 高并发与低成本）
rules.rule: Always connect Supabase via port 6543 Transaction Pooler in Serverless API routes; never direct-connect 5432.
rules.source: Knowledge-OS/02-Architecture/03-全栈AI产品高并发与低成本架构SOP.md

rules.rule: In Vercel or Serverless API routes, connect via Supabase Port 6543 (Transaction Pooler).
Always use req.text() raw body for webhook signature verification; never use req.json().
Disable server-side prepared statements (e.g., prepare: false or pgbouncer=true) in database drivers when connecting via Transaction Pooler to prevent Error 42P05.
Mount sliding window rate limit on all public API routes to prevent bill shock from abuse.
Record event_id with UNIQUE constraint in database to guarantee idempotent webhook processing.

rules.doc_title: 全栈AI产品架构SOP（Next.js + Supabase 高并发与低成本）
rules.rule: Never import C++ native Node.js modules in Edge Runtime to prevent build failure and cold start blowup.
rules.source: Knowledge-OS/02-Architecture/03-全栈AI产品高并发与低成本架构SOP.md

rules.rule: Enforce AbortController 15-second timeout and per-user token consumption ceiling on LLM routes.
Use Upstash Redis with HTTP/REST protocol in Serverless environment; never use TCP Redis connections.
Deploy /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt in public/ to reduce AI search engine hallucination.
